name: 01062 · Florence, MA
findings: ZIP 01062 (Florence) has 61 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01062 (Florence) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 01062 (Florence) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
